target_group: Indian candidates seeking fresh skilling, reskilling, upskilling or Recognition of Prior Learning
description: PMKVY 4.0 supports Short-Term Training, Special Projects and Recognition of Prior Learning through eligible job-role pathways.
benefit: skill training, assessment and certification under applicable PMKVY pathways
eligibility: Indian national with valid Aadhaar and the eligibility required for the selected job role. PMKVY 4.0 lists ages 15-45 for Short-Term Training/Special Projects and 18-59 for RPL, with prior experience required for the relevant RPL job role.
verification_note: Training-centre availability and job-role-specific entry requirements must be checked on the official skill ecosystem.

target_group: Candidates entering apprenticeship training with eligible establishments
description: NAPS promotes apprenticeship and on-the-job experiential training through registered establishments, with applicable government stipend support arrangements.
benefit: structured apprenticeship training and applicable stipend support
eligibility: Apprentices must satisfy the Apprentices Act and the requirements of the selected trade. Official NAPS guidance states a general minimum age of 14 years, with trade-specific educational and other requirements.
verification_note: Actual eligibility depends on the trade, establishment, contract and current apprenticeship opportunity.

description: PMEGP supports eligible new self-employment ventures and micro-enterprises through credit-linked assistance.
benefit: credit-linked assistance for eligible new micro-enterprises
eligibility: Applicant must be above 18 years. For projects above Rs.10 lakh in manufacturing and above Rs.5 lakh in business/service, at least 8th-standard education is required. Other project, subsidy-history and activity conditions apply.
verification_note: Jeevika cannot verify project cost, activity restrictions, previous subsidy assistance or bank/project approval from the current profile.

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
target_group: Poor rural youth, with social-inclusion provisions in the programme
description: DDU-GKY is a placement-linked skill-development programme for poor rural youth.
benefit: skill training and placement-linked support under programme rules
eligibility: The core target group is poor rural youth aged 15-35. The official guidelines provide an upper age of 45 for women and specified special groups, subject to the programme's other eligibility rules.
verification_note: Rural residence, poor-household criteria and other programme conditions must be verified; Jeevika does not infer them from a location name alone.

scheme_name: PM SVANidhi (Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
description: PM SVANidhi provides scheme support for eligible street vendors through the official programme framework.
benefit: working-capital support and related scheme benefits for eligible street vendors
eligibility: Eligibility depends on qualifying as a street vendor and satisfying the scheme's documentation and local-authority requirements.
verification_note: Ordinary retail or kirana ownership is not treated by Jeevika as sufficient evidence of street-vendor eligibility.

target_group: Eligible micro-enterprises and income-generating small business activities
description: PMMY provides collateral-free institutional credit for eligible micro-enterprises, including specified activities allied to agriculture.
benefit: collateral-free credit through applicable PMMY categories, including Tarun Plus up to Rs.20 lakh for eligible prior Tarun borrowers
eligibility: Eligible income-generating micro-enterprises are financed under participating lenders' rules. PMMY includes manufacturing, trading, services and allied-agriculture activities such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping.
verification_note: Final eligibility and loan sanction depend on enterprise details, lender appraisal and the applicable PMMY category.
